text_block_list.text: Upon heading out to the track to prepare for early morning training...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter, lack of sleep?
You were the one who invited me to train in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I ended up staying up late reading fan letters...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, fan letters...
Did you gain anything from them?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...No, if anything,
I've only become more confused...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Of course my fans are precious to me, and I'm deeply grateful, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I just don't know what I can really do for them...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I see... But listen to me, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do you truly believe your fans send those letters expecting you to do something for them in return?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well... I wonder...
I'm not sure.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then go through every single letter carefully once more.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am certain something will become clear to you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're right, I'll read through them thoroughly again. Thank you... *yaaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Reading them is all well and good, but ensure you get adequate sleep.
Looking sloppy and exhausted will only disappoint your fans.

Watching the sleepy Silence Suzuka,
Air Groove offered a subtly gentle smile.
